summaryZh: Busch 实验室研究植物基因如何决定不同环境下的根系生长，并探索更有韧性和固碳能力的植物。团队结合系统遗传学、基因组学、全基因组关联研究、成像和机器视觉，分析根系形态及环境适应机制。
researchQuestions: 在特定环境中，植物基因如何决定根的生长？

evidence.quote: Wolfgang Busch uses a systems genetics approach, combining techniques from genetics, genomics, and other science fields to understand how root growth in given environments is determined by a plant’s genes. Genome-wide association studies correlate genetic variation with physical characteristics
Busch developed novel methods to evaluate hundreds of thousands of roots using imaging and machine vision algorithms to automatically extract root length and shape data.

The lab has also recently expanded its work to some of the most globally relevant crop species with the aim of identifying mechanisms conserved across species that can be engineered to create more resilient crop varieties.
